content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Virginia Beach

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma with five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's complete eligibility criteria to ensure you meet education and hours-worked requirements before enrolling in bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led course covers all five process groups and knowledge areas over a compressed schedule, designed for working professionals in Military & Defense, Healthcare, IT, Construction, and other Virginia Beach industries.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing bootcamp, create your PMI account and submit your formal application, including proof of education, work experience, and completion of the 35 contact-hour requirement. Pay the examination fee directly to PMI to schedule your exam window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor-led review sessions—to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your exam when ready; the PMP is offered year-round at Pearson VUE testing centers throughout Virginia Beach and nearby areas.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn 60 professional development units (PDUs) every three years to keep your certification active. PDUs come from project-management training, conference attendance, publications, and volunteer work—Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses to help you stay current and competitive in your career.
